newsitem.title: UK: British Prime Minister Tony Blair sells house.
newsitem.headline: British Prime Minister Tony Blair sells house.

text.p: Prime Minister Tony Blair has sold his house in Islington, the trendy north London borough he helped put on the map as the spiritual home of his revamped "new" Labour Party.

Labour sources confirmed the sale on Sunday but declined to say how much Blair and his wife Cherie received for the three-storey 19th century house that went on the market at a price of 615,000 pounds ($1 million).
At a time of booming house prices the Blairs are expected to have made a substantial profit on the property they bought for around 375,000 pounds in 1993.

Blair moved his family into Downing Street after his landslide May 1 election victory because the security measures needed at the Islington house would have made life too difficult for his neighbours. ($ = 0.601 British Pounds)
